meta.title: Funded Economics Master's & PhD Programs Tracker
meta.coverage_note: Master's and PhD programs in Economics across Europe, Asia, and Australia that offer some form of funding (scholarship, stipend, tuition waiver, or assistantship). Started as a curated seed list, not an exhaustive census; grows and refreshes over periodic automated passes.

programs.name: Research Master in Economics
programs.repec_rank: Not ranked standalone (joint institute). Affiliates: VU Amsterdam #47, U. Amsterdam #52, Erasmus Rotterdam #56
programs.gre: Required for applicants without a Dutch degree (Quant score below 160 not competitive); exempt for Dutch-degree holders
programs.other: Strong quantitative background; max. 35 students/year; feeds into PhD at UvA/VU/Erasmus; 2 academic reference letters
programs.deadline: 1 Dec (scholarship/non-EEA) / 1 Feb (partner non-EEA & EEA scholarship) / 1 May (EEA) — recurring; page also notes Cohort 2027-2029 admissions open in Studielink 1 Oct 2026, which is hard to reconcile with the Dec/Feb/May dates shown — cohort-year labeling on the official page is ambiguous, recommend a manual spot-check
programs.progfee: EEA nationals EUR 2,694 (statutory fee); Non-EEA EUR 20,500 (statutory + institutional fee); no tuition fees during PhD phase
programs.funding_detail: Year 1: full scholarship EUR 1,500/month or partial EUR 750/month. Year 2: full EUR 1,000/month (requires weighted GPA >=8.0 in core courses) or partial EUR 750/month (GPA >=7.5). Institutional fee waivers for selected students (statutory fee not waivable); inter-campus travel compensation also offered.
programs.last_change: Filled in IELTS/TOEFL/GRE, references, tuition and scholarship amounts
programs.notes: Seed entry Aug 2026; deadline year-labeling on official page is internally inconsistent (Dec/Feb/May dates vs. an Oct 2026 Studielink-opening note) — verify manually before relying on exact cohort year

programs.name: Doctoral Program
programs.gre: Mandatory for all applicants holding a foreign (non-French) degree — Verbal, Quant and Analytical Writing all required; no minimum score published
programs.other: ~5 year program; entry is via M2 ETE (doctoral track) then continuation into the PhD — no separate direct-PhD-only application; Cambridge CAE C1 accepted as an alternative to IELTS/TOEFL; exemptions for native English speakers or English-medium degree holders
programs.deadline: No fixed PhD-only deadline — entry is via the M2 ETE doctoral track. 2026-27 M2 ETE international application window was 10-20 April 2026 (recurring annual spring campaign, ~April) — already closed; next window expected ~April 2027
programs.progfee: International M2 track: EUR 5,500/year + EUR 254 registration fee; fee waivers available on merit/other criteria
programs.funding_detail: TSE fellowships (EUR 8,000-12,000) allocated to students admitted into the M2 ETE doctoral track; one annual UniCredit Masterscholarship worth EUR 13,000; once in the PhD, "the doctoral school makes sure students receive funding" (mechanism not itemized); TA/RA positions also available at M2 level.
programs.last_change: Found entry pathway (via M2 ETE), application window, and language/GRE/fee requirements
programs.notes: Seed entry Aug 2026; PhD entry is exclusively via the M2 ETE doctoral track, not a standalone PhD application
